en-US.description: MRA (short for Music Recognition Application) is a free music recognition application, or music identifier
en-US.longDescription:
MRA (short for Music Recognition Application) is a free music recognition application, or music identifier, like Shazam
but for Windows developed by Emircan 'Jadquir' Gezer with ❤.

MRA listens to your microphone or the desktop sound and identifies the music then gives you information about the music
like title, artist, album, genre, etc. You can listen to the music on different platforms, see lyrics, see similar kinds
of music, and so much more.
en-US.name: MRA - Music Identifier - Music Discovery
